title: Hotels and flags on the Continental tour
summary: Irving Mills booked the best hotels, and the American flag flew.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: How was it like in northern Europe, like when you went up to Norway and Denmark?
The same way, all over, everywhere. The same way. That's right. The same way.
You didn't have like any problems with accommodations or stuff you had here?

We stayed in the biggest hotels, we stayed in the biggest hotels, baby. I'm tell you like it is. We stayed in the biggest hotels. Every hotel we stayed in, because Irving Mills had our accommodations in front in the biggest hotels in every country. They fly -- like they fly for the dignitary the American flag was flown, on the hotel. We stayed there in honor of us. We stayed at the hotel -- just like they fly a -- a diplomat come and stay in a hotel, they fly his country's flag in the hotel, they flew the American flag for us.
